description: List the Pulse Verity plans with their limits and prices, and the prepaid call packs and extra stream connections while each is on sale, each with a portal link. Read-only; does not count toward the allowance. The current plan is marked when the account is on that plan's terms (currentPlan shows the account's own limits either way), and when a recent plan refusal is known (or reason is given) the smallest plan, add-on or pack that fixes it is recommended. A link opens the portal, which shows the item, price and terms; the account holder completes payment on Stripe. Nothing is bought by this tool or by opening a link.

dataset.description: For HISTORY_WINDOW: the history dataset that was shortened; verified (the get_index_history default) when omitted.

feature.description: For RESEARCH_NOT_INCLUDED: history when get_index_history was refused, research-tools for compare or metadata; when omitted, the plan that includes both.

reason.description: A refusal code this connection received, e.g. TOO_MANY_SYMBOLS or MONTHLY_LIMIT, when it is not the most recent one.

name: get_upgrade_options

requestId.description: Identifier for this MCP call; not a signed price field.
